description: Blockchain data provider Allium has reported a security breach that disrupted access to its application, Explorer APIs, and data services used by businesses across the financial and cryptocurrency sectors. The company restored its primary APIs by October 28 but continued restricting certain features during recovery. Allium has not disclosed how the attacker gained access or whether customer information was compromised. The incident does not establish that Visa, Stripe, or Coinbase suffered breaches of their own systems.
title: Allium Restores Core APIs While Investigating the Cause of Its Security Incident

description: Google has started rolling out a built-in audio recording feature for its Gemini Notebook. The app, which was known as NotebookLM, was rebranded as Gemini Notebook in July this year. The new feature allows users to capture live audio directly from their Android and iOS devices. The feature can record up to one hour of audio.
title: Gemini Notebook Adds Audio Recorder on Android and iOS With Support for One-Hour Recordings

description: Anthropic has added three administrative tools to Claude Enterprise, giving organisations more insight into how employees use the AI assistant and manage its costs. Smart reports analyse team conversations and highlight potential workflow improvements, while in-app surveys help administrators collect feedback from employees. The pooled budgets feature lets teams share a monthly spending allowance, although individual usage limits remain in place. Administrators can also review requests for additional usage and receive email alerts as teams approach their shared budget limits.
title: Anthropic Adds Smart Reports, Employee Surveys and Shared Budgets to Claude Enterprise

description: Zomato could soon launch a Mehmaan Mode. The proposed Mehmaan Mode will allow the food delivery platform to hide menu prices while guests browse the available dishes and place their selections. This would allow them to choose food without being influenced by the cost of individual items. The idea was shared by a user in a LinkedIn post tagging Goyal. Responding to the suggestion, Goyal said the company would roll out the feature during the week.
title: Zomato to Introduce Mehmaan Mode to Hide Food Prices While Guests Order

description: Noise Buds R1 (Gaana Edition) wireless earbuds are available in India for Rs. 1,399 through Noise and Gaana's online platforms. The co-branded earbuds include a one-year Gaana Plus subscription worth Rs. 799, along with 11mm dynamic drivers, quad microphones with Environmental Noise Cancellation and InstaCharge fast charging. Noise claims the earbuds offer up to 40 hours of playback with the charging case. The partnership is also expected to extend Gaana subscriptions to other products in Noise's portfolio.
title: Noise Buds R1 Gaana Edition Launched in India With One-Year Gaana Plus Subscription

description: Logitech MX Master 4 Developer Edition was launched in India on Thursday. The company claims it is a limited-edition version of its productivity mouse, featuring a design inspired by software development and coding workflows. The special edition variant has the same customisable controls, haptic feedback, and precision scrolling as the standard MX Master 4, and adds terminal-inspired visual details, including syntax annotations, markup tags, and circuit patterns. The Logitech MX Master 4 Developer Edition also includes a dedicated Actions Ring button for quick access to macros and preferred AI coding assistants.
title: Logitech MX Master 4 Developer Edition Launched in India With Terminal-Inspired Design: Price, Specifications

description: Ripple’s RLUSD stablecoin is launching on Coinbase for retail and institutional customers across the XRP Ledger, Ethereum, and Base networks. The exchange will support trading, custody, deposits, withdrawals, and conversions between RLUSD and eligible dollar-denominated stablecoins or US dollars at a one-to-one ratio. Coinbase Global Exchange customers may also be able to use RLUSD as collateral in the future, although the companies have not disclosed a timeline.
title: Coinbase Integrates Ripple’s RLUSD Across XRP Ledger, Base and Ethereum Networks

description: Google is expanding its AI-powered search advertising programme across more international markets, including India, while testing new ways to display sponsored results during ongoing conversations in the US. The update covers ad placements in AI Mode and AI Overviews, with existing Google Ads campaigns remaining eligible. Advertisers can continue using their current campaign setup and reporting tools. Google also plans to extend AI Mode ads to Brazil, Mexico and the UK in the fourth quarter of 2026, broadening the feature's reach further.
title: Google Expands AI Mode Ads to India and Nine Other Countries as Multiturn Ads Roll Out in US

description: Google has introduced a new immersive explorations feature in the Gemini app. The new feature is designed to help users understand complex topics. Users can access the collection through the Gemini student hub by selecting the “Try immersive explorations” option. Google said the experiences will also be accessible directly within Gemini chat conversations soon.
title: Google Adds Immersive Explorations to Gemini, Letting Students Explore Science and History

description: OnePlus Ace 7 and OnePlus Ace 7 Pro have been launched in China, the smartphone maker announced on Thursday. The two new OnePlus Ace series phones are set to go on sale in China on November 3 via the Oppo online store. The OnePlus Ace 7 is offered in Midnight Black, Streamer White, and Quenched (translated from Chinese) colour options. The OnePlus Ace 7 Pro will be available for purchase in Flowing White, Midnight Black, and Windbreaker (translated from Chinese) colourways. Both smartphones are backed by a 9,000mAh battery and support 100W wired fast charging. The Ace 7 features a Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5V chipset, while the Ace 7 Pro features a Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 chipset.
title: OnePlus Ace 7 Pro and Ace 7 Launched With 9,000mAh Battery, 200-Megapixel Rear Camera: Price, Specifications

description: Gemini in Google Sheets has been upgraded with new features and enhancements, the tech giant has announced. The company says that it began rolling out the updates gradually on October 20, and the gradual rollout takes up to 15 days for feature visibility. The new enhancements are available for users with Business Standard and Plus plans, Enterprise Standard and Plus plans, Google AI Pro and Ultra plans, Google AI Pro for Education, and AI Expanded Access. For admins, the new Gemini features in Google Sheets will be available by default for users with Gemini in Sheets enabled. Meanwhile, other users can access the same by clicking on the “Ask Gemini” button, appearing in the top-right corner of Sheets’ side panel.
title: Gemini AI in Google Sheets Updated With Faster Responses, Improved Consistency Across Cells

description: Phatom Blade Zero has reached over half a million concurrent players on Steam. Over 640,000 concurrent players played the Chinese action-adventure game on the day it launched. Phantom Blade Zero released on PC and PS5. The is inspired by Chinese martial arts and is developed by Chinese studio S-Game.
title: Phantom Blade Zero Hits Over Half a Million Players on Steam on Launch Day

description: Samsung is expected to unveil its next-generation flagship Galaxy S lineup early next year. The lineup, ubiquitously known as the Galaxy S27 series, is likely to comprise four models, with a new ‘Pro’ variant joining the standard Galaxy S27, Galaxy S27+, and Galaxy S27 Ultra. The vanilla model has now surfaced on a certification site, which reveals charging details. Separately, Samsung has also offered us a glimpse into its mobile business and future plans, including the Galaxy S27 series.
title: Samsung Galaxy S27 Listing Suggests 25W Charging for Global Variants as Company Reveals 2027 Plans

description: Samsung W27 has been launched in China, the South Korean smartphone maker announced during the ‘Heart of the World’ event on Thursday. The latest premium foldable from the tech giant is scheduled to go on sale in China on November 13 via the Samsung online store. The Samsung W27 is offered in two colour options, namely Jihu Blue and Jixia Hong (translated from Chinese). The foldable is powered by the octa-core Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 for Galaxy chipset from Qualcomm, which is built on a 3nm process. The smartphone is based on the Galaxy Z Fold 8 Ultra. The Samsung W27 brings a premium two-tone design over the Galaxy Z Fold 8 Ultra.
title: Samsung W27 Launched With 8-Inch Foldable Display, Premium Two-Tone Design: Price, Specifications

description: OpenAI now allow users to communicate with its Dots AI agents through their phone's messaging app. The feature is currently available as a preview to eligible ChatGPT Pro subscribers in the US. With the latest update, users text their Dot directly via Apple's iMessage on iPhone and Rich Communication Services (RCS) messaging on Android.
title: OpenAI Dots Can Now Send Texts, Photos, Voice Messages to Users via iMessage, RCS

description: Bitcoin trades near $80,000 after the Federal Reserve held interest rates at 3.75-4 percent in a divided vote. US spot Bitcoin ETFs recorded consecutive days of inflows, helping offset earlier withdrawals. However, rising expectations of a December rate hike, inflation concerns and losses among long-term holders who bought at higher prices could limit the cryptocurrency’s recovery.
title: Bitcoin Trades Near $80,000 as Fed Rate Outlook and ETF Inflows Shape Sentiment

description: Apple's MacBook Pro with a PROLED XDR display reportedly features a dedicated light source for the illuminated Apple logo on the lid. During the launch, Apple announced that the new MacBook Pro with a PROLED XDR display features two self-illuminating pixel layers and tandem OLED technology. The report highlights that the thinner panels leave room for a separate light source that allows the Apple logo to glow without increasing the thickness of the flap. Apple discontinued the illuminated back logo with the launch of the redesigned MacBook models in 2016. The older models used the backlight from LCD panels to glow. However, the OLED panel of the new MacBook Pro model with a touchscreen does not have a backlight.
title: MacBook Pro With PROLED XDR Display Brings Back the Illuminated Apple Logo: Here’s How It Works

description: Sony has announced the PS Plus monthly games lineup for November. Next month, Dead Island 2, Tomb Raider IV – VI Remastered, and Monster Train 2 will joing the game subscription service. The monthly games lineup is available to PS Plus Essential, Extra, and Deluxe/Premium tier members. All three games will be available from Novemver 3.
title: PS Plus Monthly Games for November Include Dead Island 2, Tomb Raider IV–VI Remastered and Monster Train 2

description: Google is expanding third-party app support across Search and Gemini through its Connected Apps Platform, which is now available in preview. The platform gives developers a single system to build, test and submit integrations for either service or both. Google says more than 50 Connected Apps are available across Search and Gemini, with Adobe, Experian, Localiza and Peloton already integrated into Gemini. Calm is also set to arrive on both platforms, while existing Gemini integrations are expected to reach Search in the coming weeks.
title: Google Opens Connected Apps Platform Preview to Developers for Search and Gemini

description: Vodafone Idea (Vi) has introduced a new prepaid family offering in India. As per the telecom service provider, subscribers can share mobile data with other members of a group while retaining their existing recharge plans and validity. The service is described as India’s first prepaid family plan and also provides assured recharge discounts of up to 10 percent through the Vi app. Customers can create a family group with up to four members, including the primary account holder, and transfer data when someone runs low.
title: Vi Launches Prepaid Family Plan in India With Data Sharing, Discounts on Recharges

description: Flipkart Big Bang Diwali Sale 2026 is offering various iPhone models at discounted prices, including iPhone 17, iPhone 15, iPhone 18 Pro Max, iPhone 18 Pro, iPhone 17 Pro Max, iPhone 17 Pro, and iPhone Air. Flipkart is also offering an instant discount of 10 percent with SBI debit and credit cards and SBI credit card EMI transactions. Moreover, buyers can avail an exchange bonus of up to Rs. 5,000 in addition to the value of their old handset. Apart from smartphones, the e-commerce platform is offering Apple’s iCloud+ subscription at a discounted price of Rs. 749 for 12 months, coming down from its listed price of Rs. 900.
title: Flipkart Big Bang Diwali Sale 2026: Top Deals on Apple’s iPhone 17, iPhone 18 Pro Max and More

description: Oppo Find X10 and Find X10 Pro Max are now available for purchase in India. The smartphones feature Hasselblad-branded cameras, MediaTek Dimensity chipsets, and 8,000mAh batteries. The standard model starts at Rs. 1,39,999, while the Find X10 Pro Max is priced at Rs. 1,99,999. The Find X10 Pro Max runs on the 2nm MediaTek Dimensity 9600 Pro platform, while the vanilla model runs on a 3nm MediaTek Dimensity 9600M chipset.
title: Oppo Find X10 Pro Max, Find X10 Goes on Sale in India Today: Price, Offers, Specifications

description: Sony has announced new see-through designs for DualSense controllers and PS5 console covers. The Prism collection features transparent finishises across three colourways. The accessories will be available to pre-order next month before launching in February 2027. Sony said the collection was inspired by the see-through design trend of the '90s
title: Sony Announces Prism Collection of Transparent DualSense Controllers and PS5 Console Covers

description: Huawei Pura 90 Plus launched in China with a Kirin 9025 chipset and a 50-megapixel primary camera featuring a 1-inch-type sensor and variable aperture. The Huawei Pura 90 Plus runs on HarmonyOS 7 and sports a 6.8-inch LTPO OLED display with a refresh rate of up to 120Hz.
title: Huawei Pura 90 Plus Launched With Kirin 9025 Chipset, 5,700mAh Battery: Price, Specifications

description: Wobble Speed 5G, the company's second smartphone, will be launched in India soon. The handset will be unveiled as part of the Rs. 20,000 price segment. The handset is confirmed to go on sale in the country in at least a red shade. The company has also revealed the design of the Wobble Speed 5G. The phone will sport a flat rear panel. It will also feature a circular rear camera module, housing a dual camera unit. The deco will also feature an LED flash. The power button will be placed on the right side of the Wobble Speed 5G. The volume controls also appear on top of the power button. Meanwhile, the left side could be left clean. The Wobble Speed 5G might also sport a USB Type-C port for charging and data transfer on the bottom.
title: Wobble Speed 5G Confirmed to Launch in India Soon as Firm Reveals Price Range and Design

description: Samsung is reportedly evaluating two additions to its wide foldable smartphone range for 2027. According to tipster Lanzuk, the Galaxy Z Fold 9 Wide Plus could feature a larger display, while the Galaxy Z Fold 9 Wide FE may retain the current dimensions with lower specifications. The company is expected to select one model for launch. The report follows stronger-than-expected market interest in the Galaxy Z Fold 8. Samsung's latest foldables also reportedly recorded higher combined sales in Europe than the Galaxy Z Fold 7.
title: Samsung Galaxy Z Fold 8, Fold 8 Ultra Sales Grow in Europe as New Wide Models Are Considered

description: Karbonn, a brand which was immensely popular more than a decade prior, has now announced that it has changed its brand focus to young Indians. The brand will now focus and target Gen Z audiences while keeping a continued focus on democratising technology. With that in mind, it said that we should expect a new line-up of youth-focussed devices soon.
title: Karbonn Makes a Comeback in India’s Smartphone Market, Targets Gen Z With New Devices

description: OnePlus has announced its festive sale offers in India across its smartphones, tablets, and audio products. The company is offering discounts, bank offers, no-cost EMI, and bundled accessories on select devices. Among the most notable offers are on the OnePlus 15 series, OnePlus 13s, Nord 6 series, and N series smartphones. Customers can also avail of deals on tablets and wireless audio products. Separately, OnePlus claims that its average price increase in the first half of 2026 was lower than the industry average.
title: OnePlus Announces Festive Offers on OnePlus 15, Nord 6 Series, OnePlus Pad 4 and More

description: The iQOO 16 was launched in China last month and is expected to make its India debut soon. It features Qualcomm’s latest flagship chipset, a high-refresh-rate AMOLED display, and a large battery. While the company has yet to announce a launch date, it did showcase the iQOO 16 at the Indian Mobile Congress (IMC) 2026. A tipster has now shed light on the launch timeline of the iQOO flagship. It is tipped to be introduced in mid-December.
title: iQOO 16 With Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6 Chip Tipped to Launch in India in December

description: Google has introduced its new frontier AI model, namely Gemini 4 Carbon. Google announced that Gemini 4 Carbon will be available at the same introductory price as Argon. The Mountain View-based tech giant is currently working with the US government in a voluntary pre-release testing process. The company will start releasing the Gemini 4 Carbon AI model to a “subset of cyber defenders”. Google also says it will gradually offer phased access to “additional trusted partners” through its Fairwind Program. Soon, Gemini 4 Carbon will be for developers, businesses, and consumers via different Google products and services. The Gemini 4 Carbon AI model brings enhanced cybersecurity capabilities. Google claims that in internal benchmarks, the frontier model managed to achieve more than a 2x uplift in success rate for generating secure code over Gemini 4 Argon.
title: Gemini 4 Carbon Introduced as Google’s Latest Frontier AI Model With Enhanced Cybersecurity Capabilities

description: Samsung Galaxy Buds On feature a clip-on design, 11.3mm TwinBoost speakers and Bluetooth 6.2 connectivity. The earphones support multiple audio codecs and include three microphones for calls, along with a Voice Pickup Unit and machine-learning-based noise reduction. Hands-free features include Gemini Live, Quick Voice Memo and Head Gestures. They carry an IP54 rating for dust and water resistance, while the charging case is not water resistant. The earphones are priced at $229 (roughly Rs. 21,800) in the US and will go on sale in November 2026.
title: Samsung Galaxy Buds On With Open-Ear Design, Up to 38 Hours of Total Battery Life Launched in the US

description: Google Chrome got an enhanced Autofill feature. It can now fetch information from Gmail to help users fill out online forms. The feature uses Gemini with Personal Intelligence. It is initially rolling out to eligible users in the US. With the latest update, users can retrieve an order number or flight booking details without opening Gmail and manually locating the corresponding email.
title: Google Chrome's Autofill Feature Can Now Pull Details You Need Straight From Your Gmail Inbox

description: Oppo announced its global rollout for ColorOS earlier this month. Among the numerous devices will also be several OnePlus devices which will transition from OxygenOS to ColorOS. OnePlus has begun seeding updates for select devices ahead of schedule.
title: OnePlus Rolling Out Stable ColorOS 17 Updates Ahead of Schedule: Check Which Devices Get It First

description: Nike on Thursday announced the Vegam Run as its first running shoe designed specifically for India. The company says it has designed it to work for daily runs as well as regular, all-day wear. The running shoe focuses on cushioning, breathability, and durability. Developed using feedback from runners across India, the Vegam Run features an engineered mesh upper, full-length foam cushioning, and a textured rubber outsole. Nike also claims to have adopted a faster development process for the shoe.
title: Nike Vegam Run Launched in India With Engineered Mesh Upper, Full-Length Foam Cushioning: Price, Features

description: Google has been playing it safe in the foldables space by pushing out incremental upgrades year after year. With the Apple iPhone Duo launched this year, we expected Google to put its best foot forward but that’s not been the case with this year’s Google Pixel 11 Pro Fold.
title: Google Pixel 11 Pro Fold Review: Subtle Improvements

description: Amazon launched a new range of Alexa-powered devices on Wednesday. The company has introduced upgrades across its Echo speakers, smart displays, and home accessories. Its latest lineup includes a new Echo Dot with a built-in smart home hub, an Echo Studio variant with a camera, a bedside smart clock with sleep sensing, and an Alexa-powered digital photo frame. Amazon has also introduced a redesigned Echo Show 16 with a larger display, improved camera capabilities, and built-in Fire TV.
title: Amazon Launches New Echo Devices With Smarter Alexa Features and Home Camera
